messages:
Noah: Quick fun one — would you rather have an official company pajama day OR a silent disco lunch? Vote + one quick reason.
Priya: Pajama day  lounge meetings > formal outfits.
Sam: Silent disco lunch  perfect for awkward team lunches, also fun.
Yuki: Pajama day  comfy + saves outfit decisions.
Ben: Silent disco  brings surprising energy, tiny headphones for all.
Marisol: Pajama day  themed slippers please.
Toast-Bot: Current tally: pajama 3, disco 2. Suggested add-on: hot chocolate station for pajama day.
Noah: If pajama wins, what rule: video on/off? one-liner.
Priya: video optional but wear presentable pajamas.
Sam: silent disco: headphones provided, playlist voted in advance.
Yuki: pajama + optional desk fort contest.
Ben: disco + 10-min mid-lunch dance-off.
Marisol: pajama + comfy chairs.
Toast-Bot: Poll closing in 10m: pajama 4, disco 3. Ops note: file a tiny event request if this wins.
Noah: Results: slight pajama majority. Will file request and loop in ops. Thanks all  thread closed.
